Page Translator

On-device translation

Choose the language pages should be translated into. No translation server or API key is needed.

Local and private

Detection and translation run on this device. The first translation for a language direction downloads a Mozilla translation model, typically 20–35 MB, and the browser caches it for later use. Page text is never sent to the model host.

Downloaded models

Clear the on-disk model cache if you want to reclaim storage. Models download again when required.
